title: Toasty Brekkie Bagel
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein toasty brekkie bagel not much beats a big, toasty bagel for breakfast! e slapped with creamy avo, cottage cheese, fluffy egg whites, and salty feta. pair with your favourite cup of coffee and you're smiling. prep: 10 mins k total: 10 mins 1 serving (9 v, gf*, pp calories a 28 protein carbs fat fibre 56 g ingredients 1 sesame/piain bagel (ioog) 3c)g avocado 30g fat-free smooth cottage cheese 130g egg whites (4) 2c)g fat-free feta 10g microgreens ebtb seasoning spray & cook salt & pepper instructions i.cut the bagel in half and toast until golden brown. 2. in a small bowl, mash the avocado and mix with the cottage cheese. season with salt and pepper, then set aside. 3. heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and spray lightly with cooking spray. 4. pour in the egg whites, season with salt and pepper, and add the feta cheese. 5. gently fold the eggs until fully cooked and fluffy. 6. spread the avocado mixture onto the toasted bagel halves. 7. top with the scrambled eggs. 8. sprinkle with ebtb seasoning. 9. finish with the microgreens, close the bagel, and enjoy! no+es: from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: Cut the bagel in half and toast until golden brown.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado and mix with the cottage cheese. Season with salt and pepper, then set aside.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and spray lightly with cooking spray.
Pour in the egg whites, season with salt and pepper, and add the feta cheese.
Gently fold the eggs until fully cooked and fluffy.
Spread the avocado mixture onto the toasted bagel halves.
Finish with the microgreens, close the bagel, and enjoy!
